text:
maria: Kicking off 2.5.0 canary rollout in tonight's change window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Auto-rollback triggers: p95 > 300ms OR error_rate > 2% sustained for 3m. Tracking region split (US/EU) separately.

deploybot: Canary started -> canary-us, canary-eu. Monitoring: p95, error_rate, model-quality-regressions. Will post alerts to #eng-oncall and #support-ops.

emily: FYI QA caught a reranker recall drop on a small prompt set in staging. Low signal but worth watching. I've uploaded the failing prompts to the eval board: https://dash.redwood/evals/2.5.0/regressions

maria: Thanks. If rollout hits threshold we'll consider a regional pin-first approach rather than full global revert; EU traffic can be pinned independently.

javier: Manual rollback playbook (short):
- pin region: `redwoodctl pin release --region eu --version v2.4.9`
- drain canary tasks in region: `kubectl -n redwood scale deploy canary-eu --replicas=0`
- confirm telemetry on pinned version before unpinning
I'll be standing by for exec.

supportops: Draft customer note if we pin EU: "We applied a targeted rollback to the EU region to ensure stability while we investigate a transient regression. No action required from customers; we will follow up with findings." Ready to send on approval.

deploybot: ALERT: canary-eu error_rate crossed 2.1% for 4m. Auto-rollback conditions met for EU. Auto-rollback initiating in 25s unless cancelled by release owner.

maria: Hitting hold on auto-rollback. Reason: traffic spike from internal load test (perf/job-nightly-burst) overlapped with canary. Chris, can you confirm?

chris: Confirmed: internal load job launched against eu-canary at 03:08 UTC, matches the window. Noise = true. Recommend canceling auto-rollback and continuing staged rollout to US first.

deploybot: Auto-rollback canceled by manual override from maria. Rollout paused for 2m while we adjust canary config to ignore internal test traffic.

emily: Adjusted canary tag filter to exclude job-nightly-burst. Resuming rollout to us region only.

maria: Proceeding with US-only canary ramp. If US stays green for 15m we will resume EU after load test finishes. Notify enterprise contacts about regional staging: @supportops please send the approved note.

supportops: Sent: "Applying staged rollout: US traffic is on 2.5.0 canary; EU remains on 2.4.9 while we verify stability. Will update with ETA for EU rollout."

javier: Post-mortem action: add internal-job label to perf jobs so deploybot can filter them out of auto-rollback signals. Filing ticket: RD-4823.

maria: Good catch, thanks team. Will update release notes to mention targeted EU pin if applied and the mitigations we added.

deploybot: Canary-US p95 stable at 120ms, error_rate 0.3% over 12m. All clear for full rollout to us. Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/1743210001

chris: Standing down. If EU error persists after test completes we will execute regional pin and notify customers.

maria: Closing thread; will reopen if we need to pin. Thanks everyone. :tada:
